prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE clean comparison board of THREE extremely simple original mobile arcade game gameplay mockups, suitable for kids ages 9–12 and general audiences. Design goal: the immediate clarity of a one-button high-score arcade game. NOT RPGs, no worlds, no quests, no menus, no progression systems, no currency. The actual play screens should be so simple a child understands them from one glance.
Layout: wide landscape board on very light warm gray background, three equally sized tall portrait game screens side by side, front-on, inside minimal thin dark rounded phone outlines with no camera notch or photorealistic hardware details. Plenty of breathing room. A tiny clean editorial title outside each screen above reads respectively "LOOP HOP", "GAP DASH", "WOBBLE STACK". Below each screen exactly one short instruction, respectively "Tap to jump.", "Tap to cross.", "Tap to drop." No other explanatory prose.
All three actual screens use extremely clean flat 2D vector-like geometric game graphics with slight soft shadow only, crisp shapes, bold high contrast and large centered score at top. Only a small pause icon top right. No virtual joystick, A/B buttons, shops, maps, characters with outfits, decorative scenery or card UI. This is a believable minimal arcade app design, not a concept-art illustration.

LEFT GAME / LOOP HOP: dark midnight-blue background. Upper center large white score "12". Center of screen a single large thin mint circular track approximately 70% screen width. One tiny bright yellow rounded-square runner sits just outside track at upper right and is in mid-hop over ONE small coral-red triangular spike mounted on the outside edge of the track, with a very short subtle dotted jump arc. A tiny curved arrow beside lower-left part of track suggests clockwise automatic running. There are no other hazards or actors. Lots of open space. Mint ring, yellow runner, coral danger. The player automatically runs laps, tapping makes a small outward radial jump over the spike.

MIDDLE GAME / GAP DASH: soft cream-white background. Large deep-ink score "8" at upper center. A small electric-blue circular player waits attached to left wall at mid-height. At center screen a single coral vertical gate is composed of two thick rounded rectangular segments, one extending down from above and one extending up from below, separated by a clear horizontal opening. The opening is near the player's horizontal crossing line. A short faint dashed horizontal path hints at crossing from left wall to right wall. The far right wall has a small mint landing pad directly opposite player. A tiny vertical arrow beside gate shows the gap moves up/down. Keep all geometry sparse and readable: one blue ball, one coral gate with one opening, two side walls. Tap launches across; collision ends run.

RIGHT GAME / WOBBLE STACK: muted lavender background. Large dark-plum score "17" at upper center. Bottom half a tower of exactly five wide rounded jelly-like rectangular blocks in alternating peach, purple, mint and yellow, stacked nearly centered on a short dark-plum base platform. Slight offsets convey precarious balance but tower remains standing. Upper middle one new mint rounded block moves horizontally above tower with a faint small left-right arrow. A very faint vertical dashed drop guide connects the moving block to tower top. Rounded soft tactile shapes, restrained highlights, simple readable geometry. Tap drops moving block; miss the tower and lose. No crane, no character, no physics equations, no complex scenery.

Visually consistent premium mobile UI craft across all panels. Game content occupies most of each screen, touch targets not needed because tapping anywhere controls the games. Render all exact title, score and instruction text correctly. These are focused production-quality gameplay mockups of tiny arcade games, not overloaded feature concepts. Landscape canvas.
